formula: p(λ) = 2 μ (H0/R0) (λ^{-1} - λ^{-7}) for an incompressible neo-Hookean thin spherical membrane (Ogden one-term α=2, λ1=λ2=λ, λ3=1/λ², Laplace p=2Hσ/R).

inputs.R0_from: equivalent sphere of the same rest enclosed volume: (4/3)π R0³ = V0

note: Neo-Hookean spherical balloons have no second rising branch: p→0 as λ→∞. Pressure control past p_max has no static equilibrium. Letter A is not a sphere; this is a sanity bound, not a fit.
